purpose: Web-verified status check for finding a second complete all-three-modality battery dataset.
required_modalities: same-cell EIS spectra with defensible frequency mapping
same-cell RPT-like health labels such as measured capacity or SOH
claim_boundary: This audit does not prove no such dataset exists. It records that the checked candidates do not currently give a clean, runnable second all-three holdout for this pipeline.

candidates.name: Rashid and Faraji-Niri DIB battery SOH estimation dataset
candidates.source_evidence: Mendeley identifies Rashid and Faraji-Niri DIB battery SOH estimation dataset as full test data for battery degradation and state-of-health estimation, published 7 March 2023, DOI 10.17632/mn9fb7xdx6.3.
candidates.reason: This is the current complete all-three source in the pipeline, not a second independent holdout.

candidates.name: NASA PCoE Battery Data Set
candidates.source_evidence: NASA describes Li-ion battery charging and discharging at different temperatures, with impedance recorded as the damage criterion.
candidates.reason: Promising time-series plus impedance candidate, but the current local work still lacks a defensible exact frequency-vector mapping for fixed-grid EIS target construction.

candidates.name: TRI Aging Matrix
candidates.source_evidence: TRI describes a broad battery cycling dataset and 16 mechanistic SOH metrics, with raw and processed downloads.
candidates.reason: The public page proves cycling and SOH-style data, but did not verify same-cell EIS spectra for this pipeline.

candidates.name: BatteryArchive.org
candidates.source_evidence: BatteryArchive describes battery data visualization, analysis, comparison, capacity fade, and complete CSV access by emailing the maintainers.
candidates.reason: Potential source for future datasets, but no immediate complete downloadable all-three dataset was verified from the landing page.

next_action: Keep Step 2 and Step 9 blocked until another complete same-cell time-series plus EIS plus RPT-like dataset is locally inspected and converted under a frozen contract.
